title: PHREAK Pulse (Lazy Eager)
style: neurofunk drum and bass, 174 bpm, lazy eager rule-engine bassline, half-step shuffle, alpha network arpeggio, beta network sub drops, reasoning bell stabs, glitchy vocal chops, deterministic snare on the two and four, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the sub, dark futuristic mood
lyrics:
[Intro]
Lazy waits, eager runs
Two engines, one outcome

[Verse 1]
Rete ate the memory whole
Every fact, every node, every role
Alpha, beta, joins on joins
Burning cycles like burning coins

[Pre-Drop]
Then PHREAK rolled in with a queue
Fire only what's true and new

[Drop]
Lazy — eager — lazy — eager
Link, segment, propagate, defer
Lazy — eager — lazy — eager
Three-three-six, the pulse is sure

[Verse 2]
LeftInput, rightInput, propagation chain
No orphan token, no wasted strain
Goal-directed, demand-driven flow
Only the rules that fire will know

[Drop]
Lazy — eager — lazy — eager
Link, segment, propagate, defer
Lazy — eager — lazy — eager
Three-three-six, the pulse is sure

[Bridge]
O of n times m used to be the cost
Now we route around what would be lost

[Outro]
Two engines, one outcome
Lazy waits — eager runs — done
